Question: Assalamualikum , For one year or more im having (things which are going to happen in future) i see them infront of my eyes when im half awake & half sleepy , sometimes they come when im busy & working . i had two dreams continously for like 3 months or more . 1) In one dream i saw myself falling from a very high place & in that falling i catches something & starts climbing agian . 2) in second dream i saw a plain road & im walking , in the mid of the road there is a small hole ( gaddah ) like water get stagnates at times of rain , i stepped in that hole & thinks oh why am i stepping in this hole ...., What does it mean ? & lately i had a vision in which i saw i stepped in something like a coal of small chairs size & falling , and im trying to catch soemthing to save myself from the fall ..., what all these means? Shukriya in advance for your reply , Allah hafiz .. Answer ID: 6175 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 758/707=L-1429) You should get serious to reform your deeds. Your good deeds are not overwhelming your self and Satan. Therefore, you must punctually recite the Holy Quran very often, remember death, offer salah and do other good deeds. Also, you should compulsorily go to a majlis of any pious man who follows the Shariah and you should go to tablighi jamat for four months, if possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
